config.afterwear.option.enable_degradati: Makes item effectiveness depend on its degradation. As durability decreases, attribute effectiveness and mining speed are reduced according to the integrity formula.
config.afterwear.option.integrity_formul: Determines the effectiveness multiplier based on degradation (§fD§7), from 0 (intact) to 1 (fully degraded). A result of 1 preserves full effectiveness, while 0 disables it entirely.
config.afterwear.option.degradation_whit:
Items affected by degradation.

config.afterwear.option.enable_breakage_: Prevents items from being destroyed when their durability reaches zero. Instead, they become unusable until repaired.
config.afterwear.option.pass_interaction: Whether broken items can still be used for interactions, such as shearing sheep with shears.

config.afterwear.option.enable_repair_re: Replaces the vanilla anvil cost formula with a custom formula when repairing items using a repair material.
config.afterwear.option.repair_cost_form: Determines the anvil cost of material repairs. Supports §fM§7 (number of materials used) and §fE§7 (number of enchantments).
